principles: Fabric/topology truth is external authority; location data never cuts its own hole through walls or circulation.
Location data declares meaning, relationships, progressive phases and variation; realization chooses geometry/assets later.
Stable semantic identity survives proxy-to-final visual refinement.
Required beats are stronger than exact object identity.
Authored procedural means invariant memory with variant evidence.
Generated locations and singular landmarks use one conceptual data model.
External media is runtime-only and nonauthoritative.
